authoritySource.appliesTo: S13 certification runs at or after 2026-09-28
authoritySource.supersedes: earlier prospective constraints for future S13 certification runs

scope.purpose: S13 real-provider and external-effect certification fixtures only
resources: other temporary GitHub resources strictly required by the canonical S13 certification flow
scope.namingConvention: clearly identifiable campaign names such as aeh-s13-*
scope.allowedEffectsNote: Machine-readable coverage for deterministic consumption (Round-11 AEH-V2-0114 repair). Repository create/delete, issue edit/delete and all other effects are NOT covered by this authorization and the campaign fails closed on them; a future user authorization may cover additional effects through the same governed path.

eachEffectRequires: human decision when the policy requires one
governance.campaignSelfAuthorization: PROHIBITED — a campaign or model may not mint its own HumanDecision or otherwise widen this authorization

consumption.requiredInput: externally provided authorization file path; the certification lane must fail closed when the input is absent, unreadable, out of scope, or not bound to the exact external effect
consumption.binding: the lane must bind this authorization identity and scope to the frozen policy and the exact ActionIntent; a missing or mismatched authorization is a hard pre-effect failure
consumption.provenanceRule: ActionIntent + ActionReceipt alone never prove user consent

notAuthorized: repositories or resources owned by anyone other than JamesMorales04
public repositories or public fixture content
editing or deleting issues #2/#3 created in Round 10
retrying deletion of the Round-9 accidental repository
any external effect outside the frozen allowed-effect policy
expiresAt: S13 independent acceptance and cleanup coordination

amendments.reason: Round-11 AEH-V2-0114 repair requires the certification lane to consume this authorization as a typed external input and fail closed unless it covers the exact external effect. This amendment encodes the same prospective user grant in machine-readable fields (scope.resourceNamePrefix, scope.allowedEffects); it neither widens nor narrows the user's grant, and it remains prospective only (retroactive: false).
amendments.derivation: scope.resources already authorizes private disposable repositories, test issues, branches and pull requests. scope.allowedEffects lists the canonical ToolActionKindV1 actions for the effects the S13 certification lanes may request. Repository create/delete and issue edit/delete are deliberately absent and therefore uncovered.
